The indigo-sand asymmetric patchwork layers preserve the uneven hem, abundant visible hand repairs, contrasting inner edges, practical trousers, waist cord and tassel treatment, and highly polished footwear without a new accessory or tattoo.

Exactly one complete subject appears; the full coil halo, head, both empty hands, all garment edges, both legs, both polished shoes, and grounding shadow remain inside generous safe margins with no duplicated anatomy.

The planted separated stance, compact lowered center, forward shoulder, two empty fists, broad repaired torso block, and separated feet form a clear weaponless ready-idle silhouette at combat-icon scale.

The repaired cloth layers, practical trousers, cord, tassels, and polished shoes remain ordinary mortal construction; no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark appears.
